title: Bunk Johnson and the three trumpeters
summary: Eddie describes Keppard, Joe Oliver and Bunk as his father's trumpeters, and Bunk's sweet style learned from Buddy Petit.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
